utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: We can rehearse the greenhouse sensor demonstration on November 10, but this is not approval for a public demonstration.

utterances.speaker: Ivo
utterances.text: Archive H-11 suspended the public demonstration pending a signed safety checklist. I think that hold also prevents any rehearsal.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Correction: H-11 applies to the public demonstration, not a bench rehearsal. The public hold remains in force.

utterances.speaker: Nora
utterances.text: Maybe we should replace the entire greenhouse with a robot gardener.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: No decision or assigned work on the robot gardener proposal.

utterances.speaker: Ivo
utterances.text: The previous calibration checklist H-12 is too limited. I propose version B with a sensor timestamp check.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Approved for the internal rehearsal: version B replaces checklist H-12. Preserve H-12 in the history.

utterances.speaker: Nora
utterances.text: I will publish the version B calibration checklist by November 6.

utterances.speaker: Ivo
utterances.text: Risk R-09: condensation may affect the fictional sensor bench. We do not have an owner for the mitigation yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: If the mock humidity monitor is offline by November 9, cancel the November 10 rehearsal and document the reason.

utterances.speaker: Nora
utterances.text: The supplier might deliver a replacement cable on Monday, but nobody has accepted a delivery deadline.

utterances.speaker: Ivo
utterances.text: The rehearsal depends on the mock telemetry service; this is a simulated service, not a real customer system.
